title: verify.sh — the gate
acceptance: Runs xcodegen, builds app and share extension for the simulator with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO, runs the unit suite, then invariants.sh
Fails fast with a non-zero exit and a readable reason at whichever stage fails
Uses a per-worktree derived data path so parallel runs cannot collide
Acquires the sim lock around anything needing a simulator, and releases it on exit including on failure
Resolves the main checkout via `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` and writes logs and locks there: state/ is gitignored and therefore absent inside a worktree
Writes its full log to state/runs/<task>/verify-<attempt>.log in the main checkout
notes: Bootstrap. Constitution X3 forbids agents from editing this path, which is exactly why it cannot be factory work.
